sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 554 was established by Ordinance No. 23992, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 25, 1999. Ordinance No. 23992 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 554 is established on property fronting 190.19 feet on the south line of Joe Field Road, beginning at a point approximately 898.05 feet west of the west line of Goodnight Lane. The size of PD 554 is approximately 7.922 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article:

(1) PET RELATED USE means a pet shelter or clinic with outside runs, an outside pet exercise area with equipment, pet grooming, pet training, retail sales of pet supplies and pet products, a pet crematory, and a pet funeral home.

(2) PET means an animal weighing less than 250 pounds, but does not include any prohibited animal as defined in Chapter 7 of the Dallas City Code, as amended.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 554A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan must be approved by the city plan commission before issuance of any building permit for new construction. The development plan must be in accordance with the approved conceptual plan. All development and use of the Property must comply with the approved development plan and this article. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Pet related use.

(b) Except as provided in Subsection (a), the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, subject to the conditions applicable in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this planned development district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District is subject to DIR in this planned development district; etc. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) A residential dwelling unit for an on-site caretaker is permitted as an accessory use to a pet related use.

(c) An accessory pathological waste incinerator is permitted only as an accessory use to a pet funeral home and only by SUP. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. No minimum front yard.

(b) Side yard. No minimum side yard.

(c) Rear yard. No minimum rear yard.

(d) Density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(e) Floor area. Maximum floor area ratio (FAR) is:

(1) 0.5 for retail and personal service uses;

(2) 0.75 for any combination of lodging, office, retail, and personal service uses except pet related uses;

(3) 0.75 for pet related uses; and

(4) 2.0 for all uses combined.

(f) Height. Maximum structure height is 110 feet.

(g) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is eight. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For a pet related use, required off-street parking and loading is the same as is required for an animal shelter or clinic use in Chapter 51A.

(b) For all other uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Tree preservation criteria must be met as outlined in Article X. Tree removal applications may be approved by the building official prior to the submission of an application for a building permit on the Property. A tree survey that complies with the requirements of Article X must be submitted in conjunction with a preliminary plat for the Property.

(c) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) A pet crematory is subject to the standards contained in Chapter 51A for an accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-554.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 554 is located on Zoning Map No. E-4. (Ord. Nos. 23992; 25163)
